title: Japan Announces Emergency Cybersecurity Package Following a Wave of Attacks
description: Japan has announced an emergency cybersecurity package in response to a wave of unauthorized access incidents and data breaches affecting dozens of companies and government agencies. The package includes the deployment of AI-powered cyber defense teams, cyber rescue teams, and enhanced government coordination to rapidly respond to attacks and strengthen national cybersecurity resilience. The government has also legalized active cyber defense measures and plans to establish expert teams to detect and counter cyber threats using AI technologies.
